title: Decoding the base flipping mechanism of the SET- and RING-associated (SRA) domain of the epigenetic UHRF1 protein.
authors: Mukherjee, Dipanjan; Ciaco, Stefano; Martinez-Fernandez, Lara; Gavvala, Krishna; Bombarda, Elisa; Bourderioux, Aurelie; Dziuba, Dmytro; Hanser, Fabien; Humbert, Nicolas; Javed, Aqib; Mousli, Marc; Singh, Pankhi; Tor, Yitzhak; Improta, Roberto; Mori, Mattia; Mely, Yves
one_liner_zh: 该文结合分子动力学模拟与量子化学计算，研究UHRF1的SRA结构域识别半甲基化CpG位点并翻转5-甲基胞嘧啶的动态机制，属于TF-DNA之外的蛋白-DNA互作体系，但聚焦结合识别与动态机理，方法为物理模拟，高度相关。
abstract: Ubiquitin-like, containing PHD and RING fingers domains 1 (UHRF1) plays a pivotal role in replicating DNA methylation patterns during cell division. Acting as a DNA reader, UHRF1, via its SET- and RING-associated (SRA) domain, recognizes hemi-methylated (HM) CpG sites and flips 5-methylcytosine (5mC) nucleobases. This flipping triggers DNA methyltransferase 1 (DNMT1) recruitment to methylate cytosine in the complementary strand. To investigate the SRA-induced base-flipping mechanism, we introduced thienoguanosine (thG), a fluorescent guanosine analogue, at four positions in HM and non-methylated duplexes. The interactions of these labelled duplexes with wild-type SRA and a G448D mutant (incapable of base-flipping) were monitored using a combination of stopped-flow fluorescence measurements, molecular dynamics simulations, and quantum mechanical calculations. We show that 5mC and C residues are flipped with similar rate constants. However, while C residues rapidly revert to their original state, enabling SRA to continue reading or dissociate, SRA complexes with flipped 5mC undergo a slow conformational rearrangement, leading to the final conformation crucial for DNMT1 recruitment. Taken together, our findings suggest that base flipping is used to discriminate 5mC from C residues, while the ensuing conformational rearrangement drives DNMT1 recruitment.
abstract_zh: 含有PHD和RING指结构域的泛素样蛋白1（UHRF1）在细胞分裂过程中复制DNA甲基化模式中发挥关键作用。作为DNA读取器，UHRF1通过其SET和RING相关（SRA）结构域识别半甲基化（HM）CpG位点，并翻转5-甲基胞嘧啶（5mC）核碱基。这种翻转触发DNA甲基转移酶1（DNMT1）的招募，以甲基化互补链上的胞嘧啶。为了研究SRA诱导的碱基翻转机制，我们在HM和非甲基化双链体的四个位置引入了荧光鸟苷类似物硫代鸟苷（thG）。利用停流荧光测量、分子动力学模拟和量子力学计算的组合，监测了这些标记双链体与野生型SRA及G448D突变体（无法进行碱基翻转）的相互作用。我们表明，5mC和C残基以相似的速率常数被翻转。然而，虽然C残基迅速恢复至原始状态，使SRA能够继续读取或解离，但SRA与翻转的5mC复合物经历缓慢的构象重排，导致对DNMT1招募至关重要的最终构象。综合来看，我们的发现表明，碱基翻转用于区分5mC与C残基，而随后的构象重排驱动DNMT1招募。
